facts.text: Deborah believes that exercise is key for her as it makes her feel connected to her body.

evidence.quote: Exercise is key for me - it makes me feel connected to my body.

facts.text: Deborah mentions that she went for a morning jog in a nearby park yesterday and plans to incorporate this into her daily routine.

evidence.quote: And yesterday I went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park. I will now incorporate this into my daily routine.

facts.text: Deborah references the saying 'Can't pour from an empty cup' to emphasize the importance of self-care for having energy to help others.

evidence.quote: It's like they say - 'Can't pour from an empty cup.' Looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others.

facts.text: Jolene acknowledges Deborah's words and states that they mean something to her, with an intention to prioritize self-care.

evidence.quote: Your words really mean something to me. I'll keep remembering to prioritize self-care.
